# customer-reactivation-planner

> Free, self-hosted, zero-dependency Python CLI that turns a customer CSV into a prioritized daily win-back plan with ready-to-send SMS/email text, for service businesses.

## Key files
- crp.py: entry point (python crp.py demo | plan)
- crp_core.py: dormancy tiers, rules, priority scoring, plan building
- crp_cli.py: argument parsing, table/JSON/CSV output
- crp_templates.py: editable SMS and email wording
- example_customers.csv / example_config.json: sample input and config
- test_crp.py: unit tests (python -m unittest)
- COMPLIANCE.md: consent and opt-out notes (not legal advice)

## Quickstart
python crp.py demo
